test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 05
subject: general
question: Where did Gautama Buddha teach for the first time?
solution: The Deer Park in Sarnath was the place where Gautama Buddha first taught the dharma after attaining enlightenment, in which he spoke about the 4 noble truths and teachings associated with it. Sarnath is also one of the 4 pilgrimage places mentioned by Buddha himself to where his devout followers visit.
